name: Simeon Carter
role: Early Ohio missionary and Missouri high councilor
dateNote: He was baptized in February 1831 and ordained a high priest at the June 1831 conference.
importance: Section 52 sends him to Missouri with Solomon Hancock in June 1831. Section 75 pairs him with Emer Harris for further preaching in 1832. He presided over a branch on the Big Blue River in Jackson County before the 1833 expulsion. He later sat on the Missouri high council and served a mission to England.
connections: Son of Gideon Carter and Johanna Sims. He was the oldest of the Carter brothers named in the D&C, including Jared, Gideon, and John S. Carter.

sources.title: Simeon Carter, Doctrine and Covenants Central

reviewNote: Birth (7 June 1794, Connecticut), baptism, high priest ordination, branch, high council, and England mission checked on JSP. Death date (3 February 1869, Brigham City) and the brothers from Doctrine and Covenants Central. The brother John is identified as John S. Carter here by inference.
